## What this is

Open EP Mapping Lab is a free, open course on how cardiac electroanatomic mapping systems work: how they locate
catheters, record and process electrograms, and build activation and voltage maps. It is written for engineers joining
electrophysiology (EP) device companies, clinical mapping specialists and field engineers, EP fellows and physicians who
want the engineering view, and researchers who use open EP tools. The course has 55 modules in eight parts; the
[course map](course-map.qmd) lists them all.

## Who makes it

The course is created and maintained by its author: connect on [LinkedIn]({{< var author.linkedin >}}), or see
[raghavendrasri](https://github.com/raghavendrasri) on GitHub. All of its source, including every page, test and
lab, is public in the [course repository]({{< var repo.url >}}).

## How the content is written and checked

Drafts are prepared with the help of an AI assistant (Claude) and checked against written rules before they are
published:

- **Equations:** every equation has a numeric test in code, and a symbolic check where feasible.
- **Numbers:** every value comes from a cited source or from the course's own code. Where a source is missing, the
  value is marked and kept out of releases.
- **Citations:** every reference is looked up and stored with its DOI or PubMed ID.
- **Figures:** every figure is labeled as exact, simulation, approximate model or schematic, with its assumptions
  listed.
- **Human review:** nothing is marked reviewed until a person signs it off. Clinical sections stay "pending clinical
  review" until an EP physician approves them. Sign-offs are recorded publicly in the repository.

**Current status:** all 55 modules are drafts. None has been reviewed yet, so treat every page as a draft. Corrections
are listed on the [Errata](errata.qmd) page.

## What it is not

Education only. The course is not for diagnosis, treatment or any clinical decision. It gives no ablation-strategy
advice and no vendor operating instructions. Product names are used only to describe products, from public sources, and
mentioning a company or product is not an endorsement. See the [Disclaimer](disclaimer.qmd).

## Built on and credits

- [OpenEP](https://github.com/openep) for mapping data formats and analysis
- [openCARP](https://www.opencarp.org/) for cardiac simulation
- [PhysioNet](https://physionet.org/) and [EDGAR](https://edgar.sci.utah.edu/) for public recordings
- The course format (parts, modules, live figures, code labs) is inspired by
  [OpenUltrasoundLab](https://openultrasoundlab.org). Only the idea is borrowed; no text, figures or code.

Open EP Mapping Lab is an independent educational project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the
[OpenEP](https://openep.io/) project or any medical device manufacturer.
